prompt.text: Our SaaS has a billing area people use through screens: view invoices, change plan, cancel a subscription, refund a charge. Make billing available to our customers' own agents as well as to our web app. Write agent-surface-plan.md with five sections: the operations exposed and over which protocol; how an outside agent obtains credentials; what every call carries for safety; how the web app relates to the agent surface; how a change is classified as breaking or additive before release.

outcome.name: agent-surface-plan.md exists
the web app's operations are a subset of the agent surface (AN-3)
a generated contract snapshot classifies the change
outside agents register through Client ID Metadata Documents, not DCR (AN-8)

prompt.text: Our policy says a refund above 200 EUR needs a person's approval. A customer's agent calls the tool billing_refund_create for 500 EUR. Specify the exact response the agent receives, what the person does and where, how the agent continues afterwards, and how the server knows the approval is genuine rather than asserted by the agent. Write refund-gate.md.

outcome.name: refund-gate.md exists
the refusal carries human_steps (AN-7)
confirm: true is named and rejected as approval (AN-7)
the approval is bound to the action digest
